notes.title: Flowence v1.0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This update includes several usability improvements and bug fixes:


Updated background colors for several rooms
Improved handling of network timeouts when receiving mails
Fixed a bug affecting interface operations when reading mails
Fixed an issue where ignoring mails failed
Fixed a bug related to the calculation of focus time achievements
Optimized interface experience
Improved client-side mail retrieval
Enhanced room effects


Enjoy the game!

- Glowing Genesis Studio

notes.title: Welcome to Flowence!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that our brand new game Flowence is now officially available on the Steam platform!

Flowence is an anonymous online social space where players from around the world communicate with each other in a manner similar to a message in a bottle. There are no follows, reposts, or subscriptions here. In Flowence, you can express yourself freely without any worries. Additionally, Flowence can help you stay focused, find inner peace, and be your true self.

In future versions, we plan to optimize the core mail system experience, enhance focus tools and music player functions, add more stickers and their accompanying 3D objects, and introduce more rooms. These contents will be gradually rolled out in the coming updates.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us through the Steam community or our official social media. Your feedback is very important to us, and we will continuously improve and optimize the game experience. The growth of Flowence is inseparable from the support and participation of every player.

Once again, thank you all for your support, and we wish you a pleasant gaming and life experience!

- Glowing Genesis Studio
